questions.explainKo: 정답: ② She's so bad at keeping secrets.. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 01)
questions.promptEn:
다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: ______
B: I know! She told everyone about my surprise party.
choices: She's so bad at keeping secrets.
She's so good at planning events.
She's not that good at planning events.
She's really bad at remembering dates.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ④ I'm pretty sure he is at home now.. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 02)
questions.promptEn:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?
A: Where is Leon?
B: <u>He must be at home now.</u>
choices: He can't be at home now.
He should be at home now.
He needs to be at home now.
I'm pretty sure he is at home now.
He will be able to be at home soon.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ — 요리를 잘한다는 물음에 그렇다고 긍정의 대답을 한 뒤에 '난 항상 모든 것을 태워 버려'라고 말하는 것은 어색하다. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 03)
questions.promptEn:
다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
① A: Are you good at playing the piano? B: Not really, but I'm good at singing.
② A: Are you sure that the store is open today? B: Yes, I'm sure. I checked their website.
③ A: I won first place in the science competition. B: Good for you! I'm sure that your parents are really happy about it.
④ A: I'm sure that she'll love your gift. B: I hope so! I spent a lot of time choosing it.
⑤ A: Are you good at cooking? B: Sure, I'm pretty good at it. I always burn everything!

questions.explainKo: 정답: ①, ②, ③. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 04)
questions.promptEn:
[04~06] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
B: What are you doing?
G: I'm studying coding. My goal is to make a game someday.
B: I see. Are you good at coding?
G: ⓐNo, I'm not good at it yet. But I'm working hard.
B: That's good. I'm sure you will create a fun game one day.

04 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 의미가 같은 문장을 모두 고르면?
choices: No, I can't code well yet.
No, I'm not a good coder yet.
No, I'm not confident with coding yet.
No, I don't enjoy developing software at all.
No, I don't want to make my own apps yet.

choices: The girl has never studied coding.
The boy wants to learn coding from the girl.
The girl has already made several games.
The girl learns coding because she wants to make a game someday.
The boy thinks the girl will give up coding soon.

Q. Is the girl feeling down because she's not good at coding yet?
→ ______, she's still ______ even though she's not good at it yet.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ① I have won races before.. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 07)
questions.promptEn:
[07~10] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
G: Our Sports Day is coming, Siwoo! I'm excited.
B: Hi, Yejin. What event are you going to take part in?
G: I'm going to run a race.
B: Oh, me too. Are you good at running?
G: Yes. ⓐI have never won races before.
B: That's so cool. Actually, I'm worried about the race because I'm not good at running.
G: I can help you. Why don't we run together every morning?
B: I'd love to! Thank you, Yejin.
G: No problem. ⓑ내가 너가 나아질 거라고 확신해.

07 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ를 흐름상 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은?
choices: I have run the race before.
My goal is to run the race.
I have never take part in races before.

questions.promptEn: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓑ의 우리말을 괄호 안의 단어를 이용하여 여섯 단어로 영작하시오. (get)
accept: I'm sure you will get better.

questions.promptEn:

Both Yejin and Siwoo ______ ______ ______ in ______ on Sports Day.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ③. ((답지 P148L Dialog 심화 문제 pp.24-25 11)
questions.promptEn:
[11~13] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
B: Mia, you're interested in writing, right? ( ① )
G: Yes. I want to be a writer, so I keep a diary every day.
B: That's great! I'm sure you will be a good writer. ( ② )
G: Thank you. How about you, Suho? Do you enjoy writing?
B: I enjoy it, but I'm not good at it.
G: ( ③ ) There's a new one in the after-school program.
B: Really? ( ④ ) Can you tell me more about it?
G: Sure. It is held every Wednesday at 5:00 p.m. in the school library. We can learn to write essays.
B: That sounds good. ( ⑤ ) Let's sign up together.
G: Great!

11 위 대화의 ①~⑤ 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
Then why don't you join a writing class with me?

questions.promptEn:
위 대화를 읽고, 질문에 대한 답을 <보기>에 맞게 완성하시오.
<보기> 1. 대화문에 쓰인 표현을 이용할 것. 2. 어법에 맞게 각각 3단어로 쓸 것.
Q. What does Mia encourage Suho to do?
→ She encourages him ______ for ______ with her.
accept: to sign up, a writing class

introKo: 통과 80%. 심화 문제는 어법과 내용을 함께 봅니다. 답은 답지 p.3에서 읽었습니다.
